name: Easy Dutch Oven Tuscan Bread Soup (Ribollita) with Chickpeas, Leeks, Kale & Parmesan

ingredients.name: kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.

While the Dutch oven heats up, wash, dry, and trim off root end and dark green top of the leeks, leaving only the white and pale green parts. Cut the leeks in half lengthwise and rinse under running water, separating the layers to remove any dirt and grit. Slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
Once the Dutch oven is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add leeks, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until leeks are softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp minced garlic
2 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas. When the leeks are done, add chickpeas to the Dutch oven, along with broth and tomatoes. Stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (254 g) can garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
4 cups chicken or vegetable broth
2 (411 g) can diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Once the soup is boiling, add kale to the Dutch oven, and stir once more to combine. Cover and place in the oven; bake until chickpeas and kale are tender, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (283 g) bag kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: When the soup is done, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the Dutch oven, along with croutons, and let stand until the croutons have rehydrated, about 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small pkg fresh basil
croutons

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide ribollita between bowls, top with Parmesan and additional croutons, and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 cup croutons
